1.text: The function w models the weight, in ounces, of the remaining solid wax of a burning candle as a function of the time x, in hours, after the candle was lit. The graph of y = w(x) is shown. According to the model, what was the weight, in ounces, of the candle's remaining solid wax 12 hours after the candle was lit?

2.text: In triangle EFG, the sum of the measures of angles E and F is 36°. What is the measure of angle G?

3.text: A local gym is offering a 25% discount on an annual membership. The regular cost of an annual membership is $288. How much less is the discounted cost of the membership than the regular cost of the membership?

4.text: The table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of y. There is a linear relationship between x and y. Which of the following equations represents this relationship?

5.text: The function f is defined by the equation f(x) = 3800x. What is the value of f(10)?

6.text: Which of the following equations has solutions 13 and −24?

7.text: Which ordered pair (x, y) is a solution to the given system of equations?

8.text: When a scientist began observing a sample of an isotope, the mass of the sample was 530,000 milligrams. The mass of the sample decreases by half approximately every 5 days. Which of the following is closest to the mass, in milligrams, of the sample 35 days after the scientist began observing the sample?

9.text: The height of a right circular cylinder is 31 inches, and the circumference of its base is 310 inches. Which expression represents the total surface area, in square inches, of the cylinder?

10.text: The function f(w) = 6w^2 gives the area of a rectangle, in square feet (ft^2), if its width is w ft and its length is 6 times its width. Which of the following is the best interpretation of f(14) = 1,176?

choices.A: If the width of the rectangle is 14 ft, then the area of the rectangle is 1,176 ft^2.
choices.B: If the width of the rectangle is 14 ft, then the length of the rectangle is 1,176 ft.
choices.C: If the width of the rectangle is 1,176 ft, then the length of the rectangle is 14 ft.
choices.D: If the width of the rectangle is 1,176 ft, then the area of the rectangle is 14 ft^2.

11.text: The expression (2x + 5)(7x − 10) can be written in the form ax^2 + bx + c, where a, b, and c are constants. What is the value of a + b?

12.text: The ratio a to b is equivalent to the ratio 49 to 26. What is the value of a when b = 182?

13.text: At the beginning of the year, Imani has $170 in her account. Each month this year, she will deposit between $30 and $60 into the account. Which inequality represents all possibilities for the total amount of money x, in dollars, in Imani's account after 10 months of deposits this year?

14.text: The function f is defined by f(x) = (x − 2)(x − 8)(x + 3). In the xy-plane, the graph of y = h(x) is the result of translating the graph of y = f(x) up 6 units. What is the y-coordinate of the y-intercept of the graph of y = h(x)?

15.text: A circle has a circumference of 42π centimeters. What is the diameter, in centimeters, of the circle?

16.text: How many solutions does the equation 35x − 25 = 5(7x − 5) have?

17.text: On January 1, 2000, the population of a town was 26,255 and on January 1, 2010, the population was 26,956. The equation 10x + 26,255 = 26,956 describes this situation. Which of the following is the best interpretation of x in this context?

choices.A: The total increase in population between 2000 and 2010
choices.B: The average increase per year of the population between 2000 and 2010
choices.C: The percentage by which the population of the town increased each year between 2000 and 2010
choices.D: The projected population of the town 10 years after 2010

18.text: For the linear function f, f(−2) = −9, and the slope of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane is 8. Which equation defines f?

19.text: In the xy-plane, an equation of circle A is (x − 2)^2 + (y − 3)^2 = 9. Circle B has the same center as circle A but has a radius that is twice the radius of circle A. Which equation represents circle B?

20.text: Line k contains the points (−3, −60), (v, 0), and (5, 76). What is the value of v?

21.text: In right triangle FGH shown, what is the value of cos G?

22.text: Based on a model, on day 1 of an 8-day experiment, a lima bean plant had an estimated mass of 253 grams, and each day after day 1 of the experiment, the estimated mass of the plant decreased by 4 grams. Which equation represents this model, where m is the estimated mass, in grams, of the plant on day x of the experiment and 1 ≤ x ≤ 8?
